gloss: to stand rooted to the spot; to stand still

definitions.gloss: to stand rooted to the spot; to stand motionless
definitions.explanation: To keep standing in one place without moving, usually because one is stunned, overwhelmed or at a loss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{呆然|ぼうぜん}→呆然：17758_bouzen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くした。
⟦{焼|や}け{跡|あと}→焼け跡：27607_yakeato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち。
examples.english: People standing motionless before the burned ruins.

examples.japanese: あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The view was so beautiful that I stood rooted to the spot for a while.

notes:
⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ + ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ ('to do completely'). Written language and narration; in speech people say ⟦{動|うご}けなかった→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ or ぼうっと⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{呆然|ぼうぜん}→呆然：17758_bouzen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす: to stand dumbfounded
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす: to stand rooted to the spot
- ⟦{途方|とほう}に{暮|く}れて→途方に暮れる：17548_tohounikureru⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす: to stand at a complete loss

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立|た}ち{止|ど}まる→立ち止まる：04636_tachidomaru⟧: to stop walking — a brief pause, not a stunned stillness
- {棒立|ぼうだ}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to freeze stiff (with shock or fear)
